chatA.text: A · Front Desk + Lounge (familiar, but better). Clubs and DMs in one inbox. Each club has a Board only officers post on (replies stay quiet), a Lounge where members talk, and room chips for events. Easiest to build.

chatB.text: B · Tonight (fresh). Chat is organised by time: live and upcoming event rooms first, each club's Lounge as a Hangout. Rooms open before an event, glow when live, become an album after.

chatC.text: C · The Quad (bold). One named, verified campus conversation lit by the bloom, with your clubs as circles on top. Most 'all together', but needs many clubs and more moderation.

r2opt1.text: Option 1 · Everything in Messages, three tabs: Chats (DMs + group chats only), Clubs, Events. The RSVP week strip lives on Events. Click the tabs to switch.

r2opt2.text: Option 2 · Club + event chat stays in Campus › Chat. Messages stays DMs + group chats.

r2opt3.text: Option 3 · your pick · A + B mix: one Messages inbox with a compact 'Your week' on top. Beyond this week: swipe the strip week by week ('This week' jumps back), or tap 'Your week' for the month of your RSVPs. The inbox never moves.

row7.text: 7 · Club chat v1 · the build set

w0club.text: Inside a club, restyled to Option 3. The Lounge is where members talk; the Board is where officers post and replies fold under the post. Room chips: Lounge, Board, Officers, plus one chip per event you're going to. An event chat has Where and When, who's going, and the same + tray. 'Your hat' shows your role in v1 (Owner, Officer, Mod, Member); custom titles come after launch. Tweaks: on the Board switch officer / member; on the event chat switch soon, live, after, closed.

w0empty.text: Messages home as it ships in v1 (Requests stays; this week only), and the three empty states for launch, when there are few clubs and events. Each has one next step.

w0tray.text: The + tray has three things in v1: Poll, Sign-up, Event. Polls show names unless you switch on Anonymous. Sign-ups always show names. The Event card's Going and Maybe are your real RSVP. Press Play on the tray to walk the flow.

row8.text: 8 · Messages on desktop · Layout A, one inbox in three columns

d8a.text: Layout A, recommended. The phone's Messages with more room: your inbox with Your week on the left, the open room in the middle, details on the right (it closes). Polls, sign-ups and events stay phone size in a reading column. A direct message keeps today's desktop thread. With this layout Campus › Chat leaves the desktop. No database work.

d8b.text: Layout A in its other states: the Board as an officer (the Officers room and Manage club), the phone's sheets as centred dialogs, the month as a popover from Your week, a brand-new student, and a small laptop window with details closed.

d9.text: Compare with the first board of row 8: Your week on top of the inbox (recommended, the same place as the phone, and DMs still start high). Across the top: always in view and the event cards get wider, but it takes 84px of height from every chat. On the right: the inbox is only people and clubs, but closing details hides your week, and its card cannot show how many are going without new server work.

d10.text: Layout B: Messages keeps people only and clubs live in Campus › Chat. The safest build, but it is the Option 2 you turned down on the phone: the inbox is split in two and Your week is not on the club screen. Layout C: the phone screen in one 430px column. The smallest build and every feature works, but it looks like a phone on a laptop and the list disappears while a room is open. A fallback only.

row11.text: 11 · Round 2 · calmer: Your week on top, the chat grows when you open it

d11a.text: 1 · Step in. Home is Your week and one list. Open a chat and the list goes away: the chat is the only thing on screen, Your week folds to one line, and "Messages" at the top left takes you back. Press Play, then click Salsa Club or Maya R., and click the club's name for its details. The calmest of the three and the smallest build, because it is the phone's own model. The cost: switching between two chats takes two clicks.

d11b.text: 2 · Tuck away. Home is the list with an open stage beside it. Open a chat and the list shrinks to a slim column of names (pinned and unread only) while the chat grows. Switching chats is one click. The cost: there are still two things side by side, and it is the biggest build of the three.

d11c.text: 3 · Quiet split. The list stays where it is and goes quiet (smaller and greyed) while a chat is open. It changes the least and reuses the phone's rows as they are. The cost: nothing really minimizes, so it may still read as panels.

row12.text: 12 · Round 3 · option 2, refined: a club panel on the right, full-width DMs

d12.text: Option 2, with what you asked for. My Calendar is back in the nav. A club opens with a quiet panel on the right about that club: its next events, then its latest Board posts, then members. The Board strip above the chat is gone while the panel shows, so nothing appears twice; hide the panel and the strip comes back. A direct message takes the full width, with no panel. The last board is the pinned idea: Pinned and Shared beside a DM. Shared can be read from messages you already have; Pinned is new (pinning a message does not exist yet). Press Play on the first board: click Salsa Club, hide and show the panel, click Maya R. in the slim list.
